errors.text_span: The purple bars (without feature embedding) are generally the second highest, followed by the orange bars (without skip embedding), and the blue bars (without prompt pool) are typically the lowest.
errors.evidence: This statement generalizes the relative ranking of the bars, but this ranking is not consistent across all datasets. For example, in the SMD dataset, the blue and orange bars are higher than the purple bar. In the SMAP dataset, the blue bar is higher than the purple and orange bars. In the WADI dataset, both the orange and blue bars are higher than the purple bar.
For the SMD dataset, the blue bar (MADLLM w/o prompt pool) has an F1 score of approximately 92%, not 90%. It is visibly taller than the purple bar, which is at approximately 91%.
The green bar for the WADI dataset has a value of approximately 73-74%, making 75% a slight overestimation.
For the SMD dataset, the green bar has a value of approximately 93%, making 94% a slight overestimation.
